title: dsh-skin skin.json
description: Manifest for one skin. Every field except `name` is optional; `id` falls back to the directory name.

id.description: Stable identifier. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only — it is used in URLs and file paths. Defaults to the folder name.

tagline.description: One line shown under the name in the gallery.

license.description: SPDX identifier. Required for skins submitted to this repo.

accent.description: Accent colour, used for the gallery card border.

appearance.description: Which colour schemes this skin defines. `both` means it handles the host's light and dark modes.

assets.description: Asset sub-directory, relative to the skin folder. `__SKIN__/x.png` resolves here first, then the skin root.

preview.description: Preview image, relative to the skin folder.

requires.description: Host hooks this skin depends on, e.g. "#app". Informational — used by the studio to warn before applying.

backdrops.description: Optional list of background images, relative to the skin folder. The host picks one and exposes it as the CSS variable --dsh-backdrop; with more than one it can rotate through them without repeats.
